title: 2. As etapas do trabalho de encantamento de mulheres refratárias e arredias

queries.text: The original spells the name "Karen Salmanshon"; corrected to Karen Salmansohn, author of "How to Make Your Man Behave in 21 Days or Less Using the Secrets of Professional Dog Trainers" (1994). Check against the bibliography.

The original cites the film by its Brazilian title, "Conselheiro Amoroso" (full Brazilian title "Hitch: Conselheiro Amoroso"); rendered with its English title "Hitch". The film (dir. Andy Tennant) was released in 2005, not 2001 as the original gives; the year is kept as in the original.

Eliphas Lévi, Dogma and Ritual of High Magic (1855); translated from the author’s Portuguese. A public-domain English version exists (A. E. Waite, "Transcendental Magic", 1896). "Clarices" rendered as "Clarissas" (Richardson’s Clarissa and Lovelace, as in Lévi’s French).

Translated from the author’s Portuguese of Lévi (Dogma and Ritual of High Magic). The sentence about Gioconda and the hidden treasure is obscure in the Portuguese; rendered literally. Compare Waite’s public-domain "Transcendental Magic" (1896). "A despeito de um outro motivo insensato" read as "for want of any other senseless motive"; alternative: "despite some other senseless motive".
